title_en: The Fox Borrows the Tiger's Might
page_text_en: The Fox Borrows the Tiger's Might
summary_zh: 本页展示了绘本标题“狐假虎威”，背景为蓝天、白云、青山和绿树，画面色彩明亮，充满童趣。

title_en: The Fox Borrows the Tiger's Might
page_text_ocr_zh: 有一只老虎在山下找食吃。
page_text_en: There was a tiger looking for food at the foot of the mountain.
summary_zh: 画面中，一只老虎在山下的草丛中寻找食物，旁边有一只狐狸和一只蝴蝶，背景是绿色的山林。

title_en: The Fox Borrows the Tiger's Might
page_text_ocr_zh: 他抓住了一只狐狸，张口就要吃。
page_text_en: He caught a fox and was about to eat it.
summary_zh: 老虎抓住了一只狐狸，正准备吃掉它。

title_en: The Fox Borrows the Tiger's Might
page_text_ocr_zh: 狐狸大喊道：“老虎你别急，听我说！我是上帝派来做百兽之王的，你要是吃了我，就是违背了上帝的命令。”
page_text_en: The fox shouted: "Tiger, don't be in a hurry, listen to me! I was sent by God to be the king of all beasts. If you eat me, you will be disobeying God's command."
summary_zh: 狐狸被老虎抓住后，大喊自己是上帝派来的百兽之王，吃掉它就是违背神命，试图以此吓唬老虎。

title_en: The Fox Borrows the Tiger's Might
page_text_ocr_zh: 老虎听了将信将疑。狐狸又说：“你如不信，我可以走在你前面，看看动物们怕不怕我。”老虎想，试一试也好。就看狐狸走在前面。
page_text_en: The tiger listened, half-believing, half-doubting. The fox said, "If you don't believe me, I can walk ahead of you and see if the animals are afraid of me." The tiger thought, "Well, I might as well try it." So, he let the fox walk in front.
summary_zh: 老虎对狐狸的话半信半疑，狐狸提议走在老虎前面，让老虎看看动物们是否害怕自己，老虎同意了这个提议。

title_en: The Fox Borrows the Tiger's Might
page_text_ocr_zh: 两只梅花鹿远远看到他们，立刻逃跑了。
page_text_en: Two spotted deer saw them from afar and immediately ran away.
summary_zh: 两只梅花鹿在远处看到老虎和狐狸后，立刻逃跑，表现出对它们的畏惧。

title_en: The Fox Borrows the Tiger's Might
page_text_ocr_zh: 几只兔子和黄羊看到他们，一下子逃得无影无踪。
page_text_en: Several rabbits and yellow sheep saw them and immediately ran away, disappearing without a trace.
summary_zh: 几只兔子和黄羊看到老虎和狐狸后，立刻吓得逃跑了。

title_en: The Fox Borrows the Tiger's Might
page_text_ocr_zh: 连凶猛的野猪和狗熊也躲了起来，不敢惹他们。
page_text_en: Even fierce wild boars and black bears hid, afraid to provoke them.
summary_zh: 画面中，野猪和狗熊躲在灌木丛后，表现出对老虎和狐狸的畏惧，呼应前文动物们纷纷逃跑的情节。

title_en: The Fox Borrows the Tiger's Might
page_text_ocr_zh: 老虎不知道那些动物怕的是他。
page_text_en: The tiger didn't know that the animals were afraid of him.
summary_zh: 老虎在雷雨中独自坐着，不知道动物们害怕的是它自己，而非狐狸。

title_en: The Fox Borrows the Tiger's Might
page_text_en: I thought they were afraid of the fox!
summary_zh: 老虎独自坐在草地上，额头冒汗，狐狸在一旁得意地笑着，老虎意识到动物们害怕的是自己而非狐狸。

title_en: The Fox Borrows the Tiger's Might
page_text_ocr_zh:
思考
这个成语故事的寓意是：
借着别人势力的坏蛋，虽然能够嚣张一时，但最终
绝不会有好的下场。
page_text_en:
Thinking
The moral of this idiom story is:
A bad person who relies on someone else's power may be able to act arrogantly for a while, but ultimately
will never have a good outcome.
summary_zh: 本页通过一只思考的狮子形象，总结了‘狐假虎威’这个成语故事的寓意：借他人势力的坏人虽能一时得势，但最终不会有好下场。
